name: Evening Glow (Mộ Quang Song Bảo)

bonuses.rule: before the fight's 20th second your healing-over-time stacks last 50 % longer; after it, each one that ends also removes one poison stack from you.

story: The founder's furnace and gourd, the one carried lit across the steppe, the other stoppered with his swaddling cloth. Tào Mộ Tử holds both.

name: The Dusk Field (Mộ Điền Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Haze Held All Night (Yên Ngưng Chung Dạ)
bonuses.rule: healing you would receive from your own arts while the Cold Furnace is unlit is stored in it instead, and the store fades by a twentieth each second; when the furnace lights, the store is restored to you at once, and lighting it costs you no health.

story: The furnace he will not light, the seed she gave him and the robe of her grave. Diêm Tử Tô holds all three.
